avoid: Heavy wooden sticks (use foam or light bamboo dowels)
children.game_version: Play 'Boat Captain' where four-child vaka teams try to complete 4 consecutive striking rounds without dropping rhythm.

seniors.counts: Counts 1-2-3 for soft stick contact, count 4 for pause.
seniors.seated_version: Performers sit in facing pairs, using shortened sticks to tap counts 1-3 on partner's stick and resting on count 4.
seniors.standing_version: Perform stationary stick contact without row-exchanging movements.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to comfortable pace; restrict stick reach to shoulder height.

learning_units.description: Learn basic 4-beat stick striking pattern within a vaka boat unit.

social_formats.description: Four-person vaka units consisting of two men and two women facing each other in structured rows.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Men hold one 2-meter long stick; women hold two 40-cm short sticks.
movement_profile.footwork: Transitions and turns performed on the 4th beat of each stick-striking phrase.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Vaka (boat) units of 4 dancers in rows; Eke nou stays within unit, Eke loa exchanges rows.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso orientation facing partners or shifting diagonally.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Occasional floor strikes with sticks; jumps not described in sources.
movement_profile.partnering: Paired stick contact between men and women facing or positioned diagonally.
movement_profile.posture: Upright facing partner in four-person vaka unit.

signature_moves.description: Short stick dance where each four-person vaka interacts strictly within its own group.
signature_moves.name: Eke nou

signature_moves.description: Long stick dance where four-person boats exchange row positions across the floor.
signature_moves.name: Eke loa

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Rhythmic and punctuated on every drum beat.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid misaligned stick strikes to ensure safety during rapid four-beat contact patterns.

music_profile.musical_form: Stanza recitation (stationary) alternating with refrain (stick striking).
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Steady drum beat driving 4-count stick-striking refrains alternated with un-struck vocal verses.
music_profile.sound_description: Percussive rhythmic beating of wooden sticks striking together and hitting the ground over a driving drum pulse, punctuated by vocal group refrain chants.
music_profile.vocal_style: Group chant and recited stanzas alternating with refrain songs.

basic_steps: Form a four-person vaka with two men facing two women.
Stand stationary during the recited vocal stanzas.
On count 1 of refrain, women strike right stick to the top of the man's long stick.
On count 2, women strike left stick to the bottom of the man's long stick.
On count 3, women strike right stick back to the top of the man's long stick.
On count 4, execute a quarter turn to transition to the next stick interaction.
teaching.formation: Four-person rectangular units (vaka) arranged in lines
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on four-beat timing and stick alignment in Eke nou before attempting row exchanges in Eke loa.
teaching.rhythm: Four-beat pulse aligned with drum rhythm
